schema_version.description: Logical Feed schema major; v3 is the previous eight-domain contract and v4 is the five-domain production contract.

run_id.description: Semantic run identifier: '{evidence_cutoff_at}::{first 32 hex of content_digest}'. Identifies the semantic evidence, not a specific execution.

collection_started_at.description: Execution audit metadata: observed at the actual collection phase entry. Excluded from content_digest.

evidence_cutoff_at.description: The single fixed cutoff captured after collection starts and before any provider request; part of the semantic projection and of run_id.

collection_completed_at.description: Execution audit metadata: observed after all provider work reached a terminal or fenced state. Excluded from content_digest.

generated_at.description: Execution audit metadata: observed when the envelope is finalized, before identity fields are attached. Excluded from content_digest.

provider_outcomes.description: Exactly one outcome per planned provider in ascending provider_id order; v4 carries Provider availability diagnostics and the five-domain contract.

content_digest.description: Semantic SHA-256 of the allowlisted Feed projection, excluding execution metadata, identity fields, and physical bundle layout.

calendar_horizon_end.description: Legacy v3 migration metadata; absent from v4.

warnings.description: Free-form execution reporting; excluded from content_digest.

coverage_gap.description: Structured semantic coverage gap; part of the semantic projection when present.

provider_id.description: Stable provider identity; outcomes serialize in ascending provider_id order.

availability.description: Provider availability is separate from acquisition completion.

upstream_http_status.description: Concrete upstream HTTP status when a response was observed.

affected_coverage_groups.description: Configured coverage groups containing this planned Provider, sorted ascending.

retrieved_at.description: Execution audit metadata: observed instant when the provider response returned; null for failed/skipped work with no observed response. Excluded from content_digest.

source_lineage.description: Collapsed duplicate records for one survivor, ordered by the stable (knowledge_available_at, id) total order; absent on independent items.
